title: Requested individual job reader grant
description: P1 untrusted grant selection. The API verifies a same-tenant canonical subject, grantor sharing permission, allowed read actions, source and classification policy, and a future expiry within the tenant maximum. It computes grant_id, granted_at, and granted_by_subject itself.

subject.description: Issuer-qualified proposed reader; the API resolves and rechecks the exact pair against the approved tenant directory.
